cards.headline: 1. Are we comparing the same scope?
cards.body: Check the lot, process stage and recording time. If the stage or time differs, both reports may be correct within their own scope.

cards.headline: 2. Which record supports this handoff?
cards.body: Identify the source record for this handoff. Does it show the process stage, recording time and information the receiving team needs?

cards.headline: 3. Who confirms what is missing?
cards.body: Name the missing information, who checks its source and who confirms the next step before the receiving team updates lot status.

cards.headline: Give the handoff a shared basis.
cards.body: Bring the lot, stage, recording time, source and confirmation owner into the same discussion. Coordinate the next step with shared information.
